text.introduction: 55 Cnc is a star of 5,172 K 12.6 parsecs away. Its planet 55 Cnc e crosses it, which is how it was found and sized.

quotes.title: 55 Cancri
quotes.card: 55 Cancri is a binary star system located 41 light-years away from the Sun in the zodiac constellation of Cancer.
quotes.introduction: It has the Bayer designation Rho1 Cancri (ρ1 Cancri); 55 Cancri is the Flamsteed designation.
